$comment: Tile font and character set of the plate reader. To change the font: put the font file (TTF/OTF) into public/plates/fonts/, set font.file and font.sha256 (npm run verify:plates prints the checksum on mismatch) and adjust charset to the printed tiles. plateAspect is the width/height of the light tile area inside the frame; the crop block uses it to straighten a tilted plate without squashing the characters. Everything else (templates, level images, tests) is generated from this file.

font.name: DejaVu Sans Condensed Bold
